use_when.text: Use it at the top of every Public Website page.
Set Page to the section the person is in. Use Home on the landing page.
Keep the links and their order the same on every page.
Set a link to Hover through its nested Top Nav Link.
Set the width to Fill so it matches the page.

dont_use_when.text: Do not use it in the Mobile App or Back Office. Use Tab Bar or Sidebar.
Do not add more than four links. Put extra pages in the Footer.
Do not show two active links at once.
Do not use Top Nav Link outside Top Nav.
Do not recolour it outside the bound tokens.

best_practice.text: Keep link labels to two or three words, such as Track a case.
Keep Report an item as the main action, since it is what most visitors come to do.

pairs_with.how: Logo Theme Light, Size Medium, inside the home link on the left
Four Top Nav Links in the nav; the one matching Page is Active

a11y.text: Renders a <header> with a <nav aria-label="Main"> holding a <ul> of links.
A "Skip to main content" link comes first, pointing at skipLinkHref (default "#main").
The Logo is wrapped in a home link.
The link matching Page is rendered Active, which sets aria-current="page"; Page Home has no active link.
Use a header element with a nav (aria-label="Main") for the links.
Set aria-current="page" on the Active link. The yellow bar is decorative.
Add a skip link before the nav so keyboard users can jump to the main content.
Keep a visible focus indicator on links and buttons.
Link and button text are above 4.5:1 on the header.

gaps.detail: No story renders Top Nav inside another component, and its own stories show it alone.
